info.title: coda-tools
info.description: Tools for importing/exporting data from Coda (https://www.coda.io)

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID to find the table in.

options.name: --include-cols
options.description: Separated list of the only columns to return. Specify '-' if you want to specify this parameter, but want it to have no effect. [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --exclude-cols
options.description: Separated list of the columns to exclude. Specify '-' if you want to specify this parameter, but want it to have no effect. [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID to find the table in.

options.name: --expected-cols
options.description: Separated list of the columns to ensure existence of. Specify '-' if you want to specify this parameter, but want it to have no effect. [default: System.Collections.ObjectModel.ReadOnlyCollection`1[System.Reflection.CustomAttributeTypedArgument]]

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID to find the table in.

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID to list the tables for.

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID to export permissions for.

commands.name: list-docs
commands.description: List docs, optionally only those in one folder (by --folder-id or --folder-name).

options.name: --folder-id
options.description: Only list docs in the folder with this ID.

options.name: --folder-name
options.description: Only list docs in the folder with this name. Exact matches win over case-insensitive ones; fails if the name matches more than one folder.

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID that contains the pages to list.

options.name: --title
options.description: Title of the new doc. Defaults to 'Untitled'.

options.name: --source-doc
options.description: An optional doc ID from which to create a copy.

options.name: --timezone
options.description: The IANA time zone name to use for the newly created doc, e.g. America/Indiana/Indianapolis. Names can be looked up at https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

options.name: --folder-id
options.description: The ID of the folder within which to create this doc. Defaults to your "My docs" folder.

commands.name: delete-doc
commands.description: Delete a doc. This cannot be undone.

options.name: --yes
options.description: Skip the confirmation prompt. Required when STDIN is not a terminal. [default: False]

commands.name: share-doc
commands.description: Grant access to a doc. Specify exactly one of --email, --domain or --anyone.

options.name: --access
options.description: Access to grant: readonly, comment or write.

options.name: --email
options.description: Email address(es) to share with, comma separated.

options.name: --domain
options.description: Share with everyone in this email domain, e.g. example.com.

options.name: --anyone
options.description: Share with anyone who has the link. [default: False]

options.name: --no-email
options.description: Don't send Coda's share notification email. [default: False]

options.name: --doc-id
options.description: The Doc ID that contains the table to load.

options.name: --clear-table
options.description: Whether or not to clear the table before loading it. [default: False]

options.name: --input-file
options.description: Name of the file to load data from. If not specified, will read from STDIN

options.name: --input-format
options.description: Format of the input (file or STDIN). [default: 0]

options.name: --key-columns
options.description: Name of the columns to key on if upserting into an existing table. If using column mapping, this is the output column name.

options.name: --field-mapping
options.description: Field mappings from input name to output name. e.g. input=output,lastName=surName,firstName=givenName

options.name: --entity-type
options.description: The audit entity type to filter on. List can be found here: https://coda.io/developers/apis/admin/v1#operation/listEvents

options.name: --action
options.description: The audit action to filter on.

options.name: --start-date
options.description: Start date of date range to filter on.

options.name: --end-date
options.description: End date of date range to filter on.
